scoring_justification: The checker recomputes a per-point match score from the agent's CSV against reference values digitized from Fig. 4, and verifies structural trends; the primary numeric check effectively acts as a recompute because it derives a score directly from the raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for gamma_sigma probabilities from paper Fig. 4 (Na, v=0.01 au)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Figure 4 of the source paper (Surface Science 1992)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values were read from the published figure and hardcoded into the reference solution; the gold is set to match the reference oracle to ensure full reward reachability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numerical results as extracted from the published figure, serving as the ground truth for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Intermediate file storing equilibrium occupations. Must exist but not checked for column names.

schema.additional_notes: Row ordering: first all rows for gamma_sigma (phi ascending), then gamma0, then gamma1.

outputs.description: CSV containing the asymptotic charge-state probabilities for Na scattering at v=0.01 au, computed with the self-consistent two-electron Hartree-Fock master equations. The checker compares these values to digitised reference values from the original publication using a combined absolute/relative tolerance and also verifies expected qualitative trends between the gamma variants.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the self-consistent model results shown in Figs 4–6 of the original work. The experimental comparison stages (Figs 7–9) are omitted because they require published experimental alkali-ion data and the inclusion of local electrostatic effects not fully specified in the computational model.
